ForgeGrid

ForgeGrid is a portable local-network development cluster for distributing game-development jobs.

Quick Start

Windows

Double-click START-FORGEGRID.bat inside the Windows folder.

Linux

Open a terminal in the Linux folder and run ./start-forgegrid.sh.

First Run

On your primary powerful machine, choose Coordinator mode. The dashboard will open automatically.

On other machines on the same network, choose Worker mode and enter the 6-digit pairing code shown on your Coordinator dashboard.

Security

ForgeGrid only runs on your local network. It does not phone home, and it does not require an internet connection.
